China
Visa for foreign citizens:
Needed
- Visa requirements are waived for holders of diplomatic and official passports, as well as for holders of Chinese travel documents for public affairs (“passport for public affairs”).
- China has decided to extend the unilateral visa-free policy for North Macedonia until 24:00 on December 31, 2026. During this period, holders of ordinary passports from North Macedonia may enter China without a visa for the purposes of business, tourism, visiting relatives and friends, exchange visits, or transit, for a stay of up to 30 days. Those who do not meet the visa-free conditions must still obtain a visa before entering China.
